units.source_text: “没有，刚铺好的新屋顶呀，老样子，沙子会不停地钻进来……

en.t: No, even with the newly laid roof, just like always, the sand keeps finding its way in...

units.source_text: 真的，真可怕，也没办法，比啃木头的虫还讨厌……”

en.t: Really, it is frightening, and there is nothing to be done; it is even worse than wood-eating insects...
